surfaceGate.test: From the first inherited V5 countertop row through the Option-B fascia bottom, every pixel outside the measured appliance mask must exactly equal the canonical clean surface or transparency above it. V15 is a required failing control.

silhouetteGate.teal: alpha > 0 and g > r + 28 and b > r + 35 and g > 55
silhouetteGate.neutral: alpha > 0 and r > 120 and g > 110 and b > 90 and max(rgb) - min(rgb) < 65
silhouetteGate.gold: inside a declared sink tap window and alpha > 0 and r > 165 and g > 85 and b < 80
silhouetteGate.outline: within 2 px of a material seed and either r < 30 or b >= 0.55 * r
silhouetteGate.stateEffect: a non-wood pixel that differs from the V5 standard frame
silhouetteGate.woodLikeRejected: r > 45 and r > 1.25 * g and g > 1.10 * b and b < 120, except declared sink-gold pixels

rules: V5 is the sole source of appliance, animation and cabinet pixels.
Erase the complete inherited V5 countertop from its measured first row, not merely the new Option-B slab rectangle.
Draw one uninterrupted Option-B surface before restoring a measured appliance silhouette.
Never restore inherited wood, tapered shoulders, splashback ridges or perspective fragments over the new surface.
The verifier must reject V15 using the same pixel-level rule that V16 passes.
Publish only as a new reversible review draft; do not promote or wire it into the game.
